goal.intent: Validate approach for CLI help hints, --for-ai/--for-assistant mode, entity naming conventions (usr_firstname), PII protection in Cave registries, and remediation of current uncommitted diffs.

Track cli_ai_guidance_and_pii_conventions_20260908 complete: Implemented --for-ai, ccrystal entity conventions, PII-safe help text, pure-functional slug baseline, 103/103 tests passing across Native, JVM, and JS, and installed optimized release binary.

Remediated uncommitted diffs in entities.json and public-launch-readiness crystal; verified zero occurrences of full legal name across git repo; saved operator entity and PII conventions to Engram persistent memory. Exploration concluded with all goals achieved.
